sentences.text: 2.  The counsel for the petitioner contends that a compromise has been arrived at between the parties pursuant to which two co-accused namely Jaswinder Kaur and Manjit Singh have been granted the concession of anticipatory bail vide orders Annexures P-6 & P-7.
The petitioner was in custody in the present case since 20.04.2024 and the trial of the present case was not likely to be concluded anytime soon.

sentences.text: The Counsel for the State has not disputed the factum of 1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:120862 CRM-M-44528-2024 #2# compromise as also the period of custody undergone by the petitioner.
5. Admittedly, the petitioner is in custody since 20.04.2024.
A compromise has been arrived at between the parties as is evident from document Annexure P-8.
Two co-accused have been granted the concession of anticipatory bail.
In this situation, the further incarceration of the petitioner is not required.

6. Thus without commenting on the merits of the case, the present petition is allowed and the petitioner-Roshan Lal son of Faquir Chand is ordered to be released on bail on his furnishing bail bonds and surety bonds to the satisfaction of learned CJM/Duty Magistrate, concerned.
7. The petition stands disposed of.
